about_the_game:
In Silent Howl, every night is a fight for survival. A group of Villagers tries to unmask the dangerous Werewolves hiding among them, ready to strike from the shadows. But beware, not everyone is who they seem. Powerful hidden roles can upset the fragile balance between daylight and nighttime terrors. Can you outsmart the deceptions and save the village... or devour it from within?

Game Modes:

  • Online Multiplayer: Face off against friends or players from around the world in intense matches where every decision can seal your fate.

  • Unique Roles: Play as characters with special abilities. Take on the role of the Witch, the Assassin, the Werewolf, and many more. Each role influences the game uniquely, whether it’s to protect, manipulate, or eliminate your enemies.

  • Phase Management: By day, debate and vote to eliminate a suspect. By night, special roles and Werewolves awaken and act from the shadows. Can you convince the others of your innocence, or sow doubt to shift suspicion away from you?

Key Features:

  • Social Strategy: In Silent Howl, your skills in persuasion, deduction, and bluffing are your greatest assets. Use them to deceive your opponents or to reveal the truth.

  • A Wide Variety of Roles: More than just a battle between Werewolves and Villagers, Silent Howl offers numerous roles with unique abilities, creating dynamic and unpredictable matches.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a mysterious setting with detailed graphics and an enchanting soundtrack that enhances the tension throughout each game.

  • Intense Voting System: During the day phases, every vote is crucial. Who will you accuse, and who can you trust? Tip the scales in your favor with temporary alliances... or calculated betrayals.

Join the Hunt:
In the light of day, you can trust no one. By night, only the cunning will survive. Will you prove to be a master strategist, or will doubt lead to your downfall? In Silent Howl, every word matters and every decision can change the fate of the game.

Will you survive the night... or be the next victim?
